answer: Make every newcomer cross a bridge that opens only for proven work: before crossing, it deposits a jade token into a glacier vault that thaws one layer per epoch of verified jobs, each checked by unrelated veterans, so standing grows slowly and cannot be bought. Each crossing also needs a signature from a witness caravan, a randomly routed group of inspectors who sign only after checking real work, and signatures bind to one key so a copied history fails. Sybil farms must fund a jade token, wait out the thaw, and pass new caravans for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
